$comment: Platforms whose demonstrations are opened by administrator-approved access (ADS Demo Access, Commerce pilot). A visitor approved for one platform gets nothing on another. personas: keys from config/demo-personas.json that an approved visitor may use; ADS staff personas (reviewer, support) are never listed here. origins: the web addresses allowed to send access requests from the browser. entry_url: where the visitor lands after accepting the invitation (the platform's persona page).
